mapper.sql: pay25_person_deduct_id AS person_deduct_id, pay25_start_date AS start_date, pay25_person_deduct_cd AS person_deduct_code, pay25_deduct_amt AS deduct_amt, pay25_note AS note, f_cdnm('PersonDeductCode', pay25_person_deduct_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS person_deduct_name
mapper.select: SELECT pay25_person_deduct_id AS id, pay25_start_date AS start_date FROM (SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY pay25_start_date) AS rn FROM pay25_person_deduct) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY pay25_start_date DESC
SELECT FROM pay25_person_deduct WHERE pay25_start_date = (SELECT max(pay25_start_date) FROM pay25_person_deduct WHERE pay25_start_date <= #{startDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay25_person_deduct ( pay25_person_deduct_id, pay25_start_date, pay25_person_deduct_cd, pay25_deduct_amt, pay25_note) VALUES ( #{id}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.personDeductCode}, #{req.deductAmt}, #{req.note})
